title: Pontotoc city and county schools close for Thanksgiving week, Nov. 23–27
excerpt: Both school districts list the full week off. December brings county exams and a shortened day for city students before winter break.
locality: Pontotoc City School District and Pontotoc County School District, Mississippi.

sources.title: County student handbook (PDF), school calendar on page 6
City district’s November Thanksgiving break notice

facts.statement: Families in both Pontotoc school districts can plan for a full week away from class at Thanksgiving. The city and county calendars mark Monday, Nov. 23, through Friday, Nov. 27, as school holidays. With the weekends on either side, that gives students nine consecutive days away from class.
facts.evidence: Page 6 of the Pontotoc County student handbook, 2026–27 calendar, reads November 23–27 Thanksgiving Holiday. The city Thanksgiving event independently gives the inclusive dates. Nov. 21–22 and 28–29 are weekends.

facts.statement: The city calendar marks Monday, Nov. 30, as a regular school day. It lists Friday, Dec. 18, as a 60% day and Monday, Dec. 21, as the start of Christmas break.
facts.evidence: The original city calendar shows November 30 as a regular weekday, December 18 in purple (60% day) and December 21 as the first Christmas break date.

facts.statement: For county students, exams fall Thursday and Friday, Dec. 17–18. The county student handbook lists Dec. 21 as the start of Christmas holidays. Both districts mark Tuesday, Jan. 5, as the day students return for the second semester.
facts.evidence: County handbook PDF page 6 lists December 17–18 exams, December 21–31 Christmas Holiday, January 1–4 holidays for students and January 5 classes resume. City year calendar labels January 5 as the second semester start.

paragraphs.text: Families in both Pontotoc school districts can plan for a full week away from class at Thanksgiving. The city and county calendars mark Monday, Nov. 23, through Friday, Nov. 27, as school holidays. With the weekends on either side, that gives students nine consecutive days away from class.
The city calendar marks Monday, Nov. 30, as a regular school day. It lists Friday, Dec. 18, as a 60% day and Monday, Dec. 21, as the start of Christmas break.

For county students, exams fall Thursday and Friday, Dec. 17–18. The county student handbook lists Dec. 21 as the start of Christmas holidays. Both districts mark Tuesday, Jan. 5, as the day students return for the second semester.

image.alt_text: November 23–27 is Thanksgiving break for both districts. County exams fall December 17–18, and city schools have a shortened day December 18.

submission.reference: Authorized November 18 afternoon edition. The city’s dated event and the county’s original 2026–27 handbook establish both closures. Public calendar, archive and failed read-only run reconciled. Original event keys and graphic retained.
